result_text:
The four default conventions now match the files they were meant for. The new test class and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass offline (4 and 6 tests, no failures).

**Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:**
- **Gradle JS build rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` → `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.
- **.NET doc XML rule:** `.*/[.]xml` → `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **JS "Generated by" rule:** `.*/[.]js` → `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **HTML generated-page rules (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** `(html|html|xhtml)` → `(html|htm|xhtml)`. The duplicated `html` is gone as well.

**New test:** `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It covers the positive cases (`.htm` pages, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js` with a generator comment, `build-gradle.js`), the previously matching cases (`.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle`), and the negative cases (hand-written `.htm`, `.js`, `.xml` stay out of the generated scope).

Nothing has been committed.
